taxonomic_note: Accepted hybrid × formula and scientific concept verified against Kew; the iNaturalist observation omits the multiplication symbol in its taxon label. Distinguishing hybrid anatomy requires separate visual review.
look_here_first: PROVISIONAL HYBRID: accepted natural cross Chloris cucullata × C. verticillata. The existing photo shows a purple-brown radiating windmillhead from its source-determined hybrid observation, but that photograph alone does NOT certify the hybrid. Published descriptions report fertile-lemma awns approximately 2–5 mm and upper sterile-lemma awns 1–2 mm; compare true fertile/sterile florets, hood shape and parents before labeling anything more than a candidate.

comparisons.key_distinctions: C. × subdolichostachya is an accepted hybrid of hooded × tumble windmillgrass. Intermediate whorls, fertile lemma awn roughly 2–5 mm and upper sterile awn 1–2 mm can be suggestive; neither one head shape nor intermediate character proves hybrid identity. Parent photos are explicitly different taxa and not exact hybrid photos.

crew_field_walkthrough: Locate the main hub and long slim reddish racemes on the source-reported hybrid head, photographed against a hand.
Compare a verified hooded and a verified tumble windmillgrass whole head, then photograph any intermediate characters on the SAME whole plant.
Measure the fertile and upper sterile lemmas and their awns independently, photograph the upper sterile lemma profile, and seek expert/voucher determination.
what_to_photograph_for_confirmation: Rooted candidate grass + entire single flowering head with ruler.
Isolated mature fertile lemma and upper sterile lemma at 20×; independent awn lengths and hood shape.
Matched same-scale hooded and tumble windmillgrass controls.
Expert or herbarium confirmation of original source observation identification.
